milestones.title: Specialist Model Production Mode & MODEL_UNAVAILABLE Fail-Safes
milestones.description: Implement ModelUnavailableError with explicit MODEL_UNAVAILABLE status code in BaseRemoteSensingModel and all specialist models when weights are unmounted or GPU is unavailable. Wire into FallbackPolicy to trigger deterministic spectral math fallback.
acceptance_criteria: BaseRemoteSensingModel defines ModelUnavailableError with status_code='MODEL_UNAVAILABLE'
Specialist models raise ModelUnavailableError in production mode when weights/GPU are missing instead of generic NotImplementedError
FallbackPolicy and RetryEngine catch ModelUnavailableError and fallback to deterministic baselines if enabled
Orchestrator records model availability status cleanly in OrchestrationState and persists errors
Unit tests verify both AI_MODE=mock and AI_MODE=production error handling and fallback behavior

milestones.title: Multi-Source Satellite Connectors & STAC Integration
milestones.description: Upgrade SentinelProvider and LandsatProvider to perform structured STAC search and metadata extraction without throwing NotImplementedError, providing seamless mock/offline satellite scenes when credentials are unconfigured.
acceptance_criteria: SentinelProvider and LandsatProvider implement search, metadata, and download_or_load without throwing NotImplementedError
Returns well-formed GeoJSON and spatial bounding boxes for scenes
Unit tests verify provider search and download behaviors

milestones.title: Universal Evidence Artifact Retrieval & Download Endpoint
milestones.description: Ensure GET /api/v1/results/{job_id}/download/{filename} retrieves artifacts generated by both background AnalysisJobs and interactive chat OrchestrationRuns, with path sanitization preventing traversal attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Results download endpoint resolves files from AnalysisResult, OrchestrationRun, and RESULT_DIR
Path traversal attacks (../, absolute paths) are blocked with 400 Bad Request
Unit test validates download for both job and chat orchestration artifacts

milestones.title: Async Analysis Worker Reliability & Geodesic Metrics
milestones.description: Ensure AnalysisWorker executes all remote sensing tasks, writes georeferenced output GeoTIFFs and GeoJSON polygons, and calculates exact geodesic metrics (both km² and hectares).
acceptance_criteria: Analysis worker runs change detection, segmentation, and optical-sar tasks asynchronously
Produces valid result records with area in km² and hectares
Updates job status through queued -> processing -> completed
Unit and integration tests verify worker lifecycle

milestones.title: Frontend Deep Cosmos Minimal Complete Interface Wiring
milestones.description: Validate and enhance frontend views (Workspace, Observatory, Satellites, Models, History, AnalysisDetail) to ensure seamless API integration, error boundaries, and Deep Cosmos Minimal aesthetics.
acceptance_criteria: All views render cleanly and consume live backend endpoints
Workspace MapLibre GL split-pane bitemporal swipe, SSE live console, and Evidence Inspector function properly
TypeScript type check and Vite build succeed with zero errors

milestones.title: Full System Integration, Test Suite & Self-Healing Verification
milestones.description: Run the entire pytest suite, frontend build, and end-to-end API probes. Ensure 100% test pass rate, strict typing, and zero placeholder mocks in production paths.
acceptance_criteria: pytest passes 100% with no regressions
frontend production build passes with 0 errors
System is fully production-ready
